operation_details.item: The user pitched a group of investors in the roadshow.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Just got back from the roadshow — I pitched a group of investors there, and honestly it went better than I expected.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Glad to hear it. What made it better than expected?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The deck was finally solid, and I'd updated the financial model the night before, so I felt prepared. A few investors actually engaged with the numbers.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a good sign. Are you planning follow-ups?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, I've got follow-up meetings scheduled with several of them already. Now it's about execution, not just pitch polish.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. What's the next milestone you're aiming for?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Getting past the initial hype and proving the unit economics. That's what actually scales a business.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Right. Too many founders get caught up in the roadshow buzz. Sounds like you're focused on the right thing.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. The pitch is just the door-opener. The work after is what counts.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Well, keep that mindset and you'll be in good shape. Let me know if you want to bounce ideas around.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I pitched investors in the roadshow; keep the deck, financial model, and follow-up meetings.
